research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: mirror of K12-01 in keller-groupoids; its status there is llm proved

value.statement: Étale-maximal Keller maps correspond to active monodromy data whose canonical étale filling is affine space; the Jacobian-conjecture counterexample condition is equivalent to existence of a nontrivial active datum whose étale filling contains a dense open A^n.

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build

value.statement: For every complex Keller map f:A^n→A^n, R_f=A^n×_f A^n ⇒ A^n is a thin étale equivalence-relation groupoid and K_r(f) is its Čech nerve.

value.statement: If G≤S_d is the monodromy group over the proper locus, connected components of \operatorname{Conf}_k correspond to G-orbits on ordered k-tuples of distinct sheets; \operatorname{Conf}_k is irreducible iff G is k-transitive.
